name: Wanderer’s Staff (Greater)
text:
The outlines of topographical maps are burned into this wooden staff's surface, though they constantly change to reflect the surrounding terrain. While wielding this staff, you get a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to Sense Direction or Subsist in the wild.

---
Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.
- Cantrip Know the Way

- 1st Alarm, Breadcrumbs

- 2nd Create Food, Environmental Endurance, Marvelous Mount

- 3rd Cleanse Cuisine, Spontaneous Cartography

- 4th Create Food, Unfettered Movement

---
Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
